# DeepSeek Harness Desktop

> DeepSeek Harness Desktop is an open-source, community-maintained AI workspace for conversations, projects, plugins and local memory. Desktop 5.3.5 includes the official DSH 0.2.2-rc.5 runtime and Web UI.

## Desktop 5.3.5

- Release tag: desktop-v5.3.5
- Published: 2026-11-20
- Source commit: c0711f974b159ad930cc7d1a6da0826fca3c6d2f
- Platforms: Windows 10/11 x64, macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon (Preview), Linux x64 (Preview)
- License: BSD-3-Clause

### Highlights

- Windows in-place upgrades preserve the existing installation, data, conversations and configuration.
- The conversation sidebar focuses on chats and projects. The Extension Dock groups tools, and Community Workshop appears in plugin discovery.
- Long replies require fewer repeated layout and paint passes. Lists and Shared Browser resources load when needed.
- Personal Preferences manages local memory by global, project and session scope. Model suggestions are saved after confirmation.
- The official DSH RC5 runtime powers the application. Conversation Context can be inspected in the side panel or with `/context`.
